title: The Mystery of the Bloodline
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was about to respond, an elderly yet commanding aura suddenly descended. Ling Yuan's figure emerged slowly from the shadows, his turbid old eyes carrying an indescribably complex emotion.

text.content: Night wind cut like a blade across the rocky terrain of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, his robes rustling loudly. Beneath that usually calm face, dark tides were surging. Ye Qing's words just now had been like a key, completely unlocking the chains sealed deep in his heart—the blood relationship between the Demonic Path Commander and the creator of the Tianji Record, Chen Xuan. This information was overwhelming.

dialogue.content: What, scared?

text.content: Ye Qing leaned casually against a piece of blue stone, the temperament of a Demonic Saint radiating bewitching charm intertwined with danger at this moment. She gazed at Chen Ji's back, a meaningful arc curving at the corner of her lips. She knew this seemingly worthless servant disciple was no ordinary man—otherwise she would not have risked cooperating with him.

dialogue.content: What is the Demonic Path Commander's name?
Chen Xuan.

text.content: These two characters struck like thunder, exploding in Chen Ji's mind. His entire body shuddered violently, pupils contracting sharply—Chen Xuan, that was precisely the creator's name recorded on the Tianji Record Fragment, the existence that Mo Xiansheng guarded in remnant soul form. How could this name appear on the Demonic Path Commander?

dialogue.content: As far as I know, this Demonic Path Commander dominated the world a thousand years ago and was a fellow disciple with the founder of our Holy Sect. The legend of the Tianji Record is widely spread in the Demonic Path—it is said to have been created by a remarkable person named Chen Xuan, and that remarkable person's bloodline has never been extinguished.

text.content: Chen Ji's heart suddenly raced faster. He unconsciously clenched his fist, knuckles whitening from the force. Ye Qing's words were like a sharp scalpel, precisely dissecting a corner of the mystery surrounding his origins. If that Demonic Path Commander truly was Chen Xuan, then the inheritance of the Tianji Record...

dialogue.content: What are you trying to tell me by sharing this?

Ye Qing laughed lightly, rising and walking closer to Chen Ji, her gaze burning intensely as she stared into his eyes: 'Have you ever wondered why the Tianji Record chose you? Chose a worthless servant like you?'

text.content: Before the words even finished, Chen Ji felt a burning sensation in his chest. This was a peculiarity he had never revealed before others—the Tianji Record Fragment actually trembled on its own at this moment, as if sensing some kind of summoning. At the same time, a violent power erupted from the depths of his bloodline, surging upward along the meridians, leaving a scorched trail wherever it passed.

dialogue.content: This is... Blood Resonance!

text.content: Ye Qing's voice suddenly rose sharply, and a rare expression of shock appeared on that enchanting face. She retreated several steps abruptly, demonic energy surging around her body, yet not in an attacking posture but rather instinctive defense—she was afraid, afraid of the aura Chen Ji was emanating at this moment.

Chen Ji felt his consciousness being pulled by some force, fragmentary images flickering through his mind like a carousel—a towering mountain peak, a white-robed figure standing with hands clasped behind his back; an ancient book emanating golden light suspended in mid-air; and a voice echoing in his ears: 'The Heavenly Secrets bloodline, passed down like torches...'

choice.prompt: In the intense pain of bloodline awakening, Chen Ji needs to make a choice—

choices.description: While taking advantage of the bloodline awakening, follow the clues to interrogate Ye Qing about all the connections between Chen Xuan and the Demonic Path Commander. The risk is extremely high, but key intelligence may be obtained.
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing might take the chance to probe for more

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth, forcibly suppressing the surging power within his body, and asked word by word: 'What exactly is the relationship between Chen Xuan and the Demonic Path Commander?'

dialogue.content: The same person. Or rather... the same soul inhabiting different bodies.

choices.description: Feigning the agony of bloodline loss to cover up the Tianji Record's reaction, preventing Ye Qing from noticing any further clues. Seemingly cautious but actually concealing hidden intentions.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve hidden trump card without exposure
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may see through the disguise

text.content: Chen Ji let out a muffled groan, staggering backward, feigning pain as he grabbed the nearby boulder. He deliberately made his face turn deathly pale, cold sweat beading on his forehead, looking completely like someone whose bloodline was out of control—a flawless performance.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing frowned slightly at the sight, but ultimately didn't press further, merely studying Chen Ji thoughtfully—she suspected something but couldn't find any flaws.

choices.description: Since the bloodline responds so strongly, perhaps this is destiny. Embrace the calling of this Heavenly Secrets bloodline and see where it leads.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, slowly closing his eyes, releasing his suppression of the power within. In an instant, a dazzling golden light burst from his chest, transforming into countless tiny runes circling his body—those were the characters of the Tianji Record, written in Chen Xuan's hand!

dialogue.content: Impossible... This is a complete bloodline imprint! How do you have...

text.content: Just then, an elderly voice echoed in Chen Ji's mind—Mo Xiansheng's voice, carrying urgency and warning: 'Young master, quickly suppress your aura! The bloodline imprint on you has been activated. If you don't suppress it, strong cultivators within a thousand li can sense your location!'

Chen Ji's heart seized, suddenly realizing the severity of the situation. Just as he was about to suppress his aura, a second message reached his ears—this one appearing directly in the depths of his consciousness, not Mo Xiansheng's voice, but an ancient, mysterious inheritance:

dialogue.content: Chen bloodline, passed down in order. Ji is the direct grandson of Xuan. The Tianji Record is not an external object, but a precious treasure guarded by the Chen family for generations.

text.content: Grandson! These two words exploded in Chen Ji's consciousness like thunder. He finally understood—the Tianji Record was not a serendipitous encounter, but a heavy artifact of family inheritance; Chen Xuan was not some unattainable legend, but his ancestor; and that commander who had terrified the Demonic Path for a thousand years was very likely Chen Xuan's other body, preserved through some secret technique!

Chen Ji's breathing suddenly quickened. The mystery of his identity was so tortuous—if the Demonic Path commander truly was Chen Xuan, weren't they blood relatives? But the righteous path and the Demonic Path were sworn enemies. Once this blood relation was exposed, how would he handle himself? How could the Tianqing Sect possibly tolerate a disciple with blood ties to the Demonic Path?

choice.prompt: Facing this truth that could overturn everything, Chen Ji fell into deep contemplation—

choices.description: The Demonic Path Saint must know more details. Seize this opportunity to interrogate clearly the relationship between the Demonic Path commander and Chen Xuan, as well as her purpose in revealing this information.
choices.risk_hint: May fall right into Ye Qing's scheme

dialogue.content: Ye Qing, how much do you really know? Chen Xuan and the Demonic Path commander—what exactly happened between them?
Ye Qing's smile grew more playful: "Want to know? That depends on what price you're willing to pay, Junior Chen."

choices.description: Suppressing the shock deep in his heart, he concluded the conversation without revealing any clues, privately digesting this truth that could change everything.
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing might grow even more suspicious

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the surging emotions. He forced a weak smile and waved his hand at Ye Qing: "Thank you for the information. Today my bloodline feels abnormal, I need to meditate and regulate my qi first... This matter, let's discuss it later."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's gaze lingered on Chen Ji's face for a moment, nodding with a knowing smile—she didn't expose him, but those eyes clearly said: interesting.

choices.description: Since the bloodline mark has responded, why not try activating more functions of the Tianji Record Fragment now and verify the connection with Chen Xuan.
choices.risk_hint: Expose the existence of Tianji Record

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no longer. With a thought, the Tianji Record Fragment slowly unfolded in his consciousness sea. This time, he tried using his bloodline as the guide to communicate with the dormant seal within the fragment—suddenly, a warm current gushed out from the fragment, blending and resonating with the bloodline power within him.

A blurry image surfaced in his mind: a majestic palace, corpses scattered everywhere, and a white-robed figure kneeling in a pool of blood, cradling a broken ancient book in their arms—that book's appearance was remarkably similar to the Tianji Record Fragment.

The image was too blurry; Chen Ji could only make out some vague outlines. But one thing he could be certain of—the white-robed figure's face bore a seventy percent resemblance to his own. Grandfather and grandson, connected by blood, spanning a thousand years of time intersecting at this moment.

Just as Chen Ji was lost in this shocking vision, a faint sensation of being watched came from the darkness. How sharp was his perception? He instantly caught that divine sense hidden dozens of zhang away—that aura was aged and profound, carrying a hint of coldness.

Ling Yuan! Chen Ji's heart went cold. This old fox of the Tianqing Sect had actually been watching in secret? The commotion from his bloodline awakening just now, and his conversation with Ye Qing... how much had been overheard? His fists unconsciously clenched tight, fingernails digging deep into his palms.

A moment later, that divine sense quietly withdrew without alerting anyone. But Chen Ji knew Ling Yuan was by no means kind—this old sect master's covetousness toward the Tianji Record had been long-standing. If he learned of the bloodline connection between Chen Ji and Chen Xuan... the consequences would be unthinkable.

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan quietly withdrew, but the crisis was not yet resolved—

choices.description: Since Ling Yuan has already become suspicious, why not strike first and design a way to probe the old sect master's true intentions. Know yourself and your enemy, and you will never be defeated.
choices.visible_cost: High risk of alerting the enemy

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered, and he decided to retreat in order to advance. He deliberately coughed loudly several times, calling out in a clear voice toward the direction where Ling Yuan's spiritual sense had vanished: "The night is deep and the dew is heavy, why must the old Sect Master skulk about so stealthily? Since you've come, why not reveal yourself and have a chat?"

The words fell, and all around was deathly silence. Ye Qing frowned slightly, clearly having sensed that probing gaze from before as well. But no matter how Chen Ji probed, there was no response from the shadows—Ling Yuan clearly had no intention of exposing himself.

choices.description: Since Ling Yuan chose to retreat, it shows he still has concerns. We might as well hold our position, quietly await developments, and see what this old fox will do next.
choices.risk_hint: May miss the opportunity for the first move

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his gaze, his expression returning to its usual state. He gave Ye Qing a slight nod: "I need time to digest today's events. Our cooperation remains unchanged—but if you dare to use me..."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing laughed lightly: "Rest assured, Brother Chen, we're on the same boat. Your secret, I'll keep it for you."

choices.description: This place is no longer safe. Immediately separate from Ye Qing, each finding a concealed spot to reconvene and discuss strategies, avoiding being spied on by others again.

text.content: Chen Ji rose decisively, casting a meaningful glance at Ye Qing: "This place isn't suitable for staying. Three days later, at the old Tianji Pavilion site. We'll meet there." With that, his figure flashed and vanished into the night like a residual shadow. His speed was so swift that even Ye Qing was slightly stunned.

dialogue.content: Gazing at the direction where Chen Ji had disappeared, Ye Qing murmured to himself: "Interesting... thistrash of a junior brother hides even deeper than I do."

text.content: However, less than the time it takes to drink a cup of tea after Chen Ji left, a withered figure slowly emerged from the shadows. Ling Yuan stood with hands clasped behind his back, his turbid old eyes gleaming with complex light under the moonlight. He had indeed heard the crucial information just now—Chen Xuan's bloodline, the Tianji Record's inheritance, and Chen Ji's anomalous bloodline reaction.

dialogue.content: Chen Xuan's direct grandson... Hmph, I've been waiting for this day for eighty years.

text.content: A meaningful curve slowly formed at the corner of Ling Yuan's lips. Back then, he had been selected as an inheritor candidate for the Tianji Record, yet everything was ultimately taken away by Chen Xuan. Now Chen Xuan's direct grandson is right before his eyes, and he possesses the fragmented Tianji Record—Isn't this a fat morsel delivered to his doorstep by heaven?

Unfortunately, this boy's alertness is higher than imagined. Ling Yuan narrowed his eyes, secretly calculating in his heart. Chen Ji's performance tonight seemed panicked but actually left余地 everywhere—he even proactively called out to probe, indicating the other party had already sensed his窥视. This kind of sophistication is absolutely not the scheming atrash disciple should possess.

Forget it, for now let him live a few more days. Ling Yuan sneered, his form dissolving into wisp of blue smoke, vanishing into the night. The secret of the Tianji Record, he was determined to obtain; and Chen Ji's Chen family bloodline was an unexpected bonus—as long as he refined this kid into an elixir, Ling Yuan would be able to supplement his incomplete foundation, break through his constraints, and ascend to the Great Dao!

At the same time, dozens of li away in the depths of a dense forest, Chen Ji leaned against an ancient tree, breathing heavily. The bloodline awakening just now had consumed too much of his energy; at this moment, he felt浑身酸软无力, as if all his qi and blood had been emptied. But what frightened him even more were the cascading truths—Chen Xuan was his ancestor, the Tianji Record was family inheritance, and that invincible绝世强者 who terrified the demonic path might be his blood relative.

What does this mean? Chen Ji closed his eyes in contemplation. If the demonic path commander truly is Chen Xuan's other physical body, then he and Chen Ji share the same origin. But the righteous path and demonic path have been bitter enemies for a thousand years—once this blood relation is exposed, he will become an enemy of all righteous factions under heaven. The Tianqing Sect will never shelter a disciple with demonic path connections, and that old fox Ling Yuan... is probably already sharpening his knives in the shadows.

Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, a sharp cold light flickering in his pupils. He Chen Ji was never sometrash to be slaughtered at will—since fate has pushed him to this critical juncture, then he will take the initiative to control his own destiny. So what if he has Chen Xuan's bloodline? So what about the Tianji Record's inheritance? He will use facts to tell everyone: the true protagonist is always himself.

However, just as he prepared to rise and leave, a familiar aura suddenly approached. Chen Ji's pupils contracted, and he looked up to see—under the moonlight, a tall and cold figure stood quietly not far away. It was Su Qingyao, the Inner Sect Senior Fellow, the only woman who had repeatedly come close to uncovering the truth.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, I've been looking for you for so long.

text.content: Su Qingyao's voice was cold as frost, yet carried an imperceptible hint of concern. She approached slowly, her gaze like a blade sweeping over Chen Ji's disheveled appearance, her brow slightly furrowing: What's wrong with you? Why is your qi so chaotic? And... this scent on you, it doesn't seem like an ordinary Bloodline Awakening.

Chen Ji's heart sank—Su Qingyao's perceptiveness far exceeded ordinary people, and she had likely already sensed the abnormality in his bloodline. He quickly composed himself, adopting a weak and powerless expression, and spoke in a hoarse voice: Senior Su... I was cultivating in the Back Mountain earlier and accidentally suffered a deviation in cultivation. Fortunately, Junior Ye Qing happened to pass by and came to my aid...

dialogue.content: Ye Qing? The Holy Sect's Saint of the Demonic Path?

text.content: Su Qingyao's eyes instantly turned sharp, spiritual energy faintly stirring around her body. She instinctively positioned herself in front of Chen Ji, her gaze scanning the surroundings with vigilance: Chen Ji, you honestly tell me—why would Ye Qing appear at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain? What deal exists between you two?

Moonlight fell like water upon the dense forest. Su Qingyao's cold features appeared especially captivating under the moonlight, yet the vigilance and doubt burning in her eyes made Chen Ji's heart alert. This woman was far too sharp—each time she nearly pierced through his disguise. Tonight's matter would undoubtedly require more elaborate explanations...

Just as Chen Ji contemplated how to respond to Su Qingyao's inquiries, a gust of night wind swept past, carrying a faint trace of bloody stench. Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted—he was all too familiar with this scent. It was the unique aura of death when cultivators perished. It seemed the Tianqing Sect was far from peaceful tonight...

At that moment, a figure darted over from the direction of the Tianqing Sect—it was a patrol disciple of the sect. The disciple's face was deathly pale; upon seeing Su Qingyao, he immediately dropped to one knee, his voice trembling as he reported: Senior Su! Something terrible has happened! Three Inner Sect disciples have died mysteriously within the sect! The sect master is furious and demands a thorough investigation of the entire sect!

Su Qingyao's expression shifted drastically. She glanced deeply at Chen Ji, her eyes a complex weave of vigilance and concern—yet clearly this was not the time to pursue the truth. She coldly snorted, turned, and was about to leave with the patrol disciple, but before departing, she coldly left behind these words: I'll remember this matter for now. Chen Ji, you better pray you're unrelated to those murders—otherwise...

Before her words finished, Su Qingyao's figure had vanished into the night. Chen Ji gazed at the direction she departed, yet a meaningful smile slowly curved at the corner of his mouth. Three Inner Sect disciples died mysteriously? Bizarre death circumstances? Heh, how interesting... Was this sudden murder a coincidence, or was someone secretly orchestrating events? And what variables would Su Qingyao's appearance bring to this intricate chess game?

Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to stand. Too much had happened tonight—the shock of Bloodline Awakening, the crisis of his identity being exposed, Ling Yuan's covert observation, Su Qingyao's sudden appearance, and this bizarre murder case. Everything pointed to one fact: a storm was approaching, and he must seize the initiative in this upcoming upheaval.

He raised his head to gaze toward the distant Tianqing Sect, his eyes flickering with profound light. Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in his mind: 'Young master, tonight's events may harbor hidden dangers. The death circumstances of those three disciples... this old servant faintly recognizes them. You must act with caution, young master.'

Chen Ji nodded slightly, about to turn and leave, when suddenly—a withered yet domineering aura surged forth like a monstrous wave, instantly enveloping the entire forest where he stood. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply as he looked up. Beneath the moonlight, a familiar figure was slowly materializing.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, walking alone late at night—could there be something troubling you?

text.content: Ling Yuan's voice was not loud, yet it came as if from the Nine Abyssian Depths, carrying a bone-penetrating chill. Those murky old eyes flickered with complex light beneath the moonlight—scrutiny, greed, and an indescribable anticipation. He simply stood there before Chen Ji, his hunched form exuding a suffocating pressure.

Chen Ji's heart violently sank. That窥视 (covert observation) from earlier had indeed been Ling Yuan—this old fox had finally lost patience and appeared in person. What was worse, his timing was too coincidental, as if he had long anticipated Chen Ji being here. Had he been followed, or... had someone secretly passed information?

Ling Yuan walked closer step by step, each step striking Chen Ji's heartstrings. Moonlight stretched his shadow extremely long, like a beast opening its bloody mouth, slowly devouring its prey. Chen Ji forcefully suppressed his inner unrest, bowed respectfully, his voice respectful yet trembling: Disciple... disciple was cultivating late at night and accidentally injured his meridians, thus recuperating here. I wonder what brings the sect master here so late at night?

Ling Yuan did not answer immediately. His gaze lingered on Chen Ji for a long while, the depths of those murky eyes resembling an unfathomable abyss, making it impossible to glimpse his true thoughts. After a long pause, he suddenly chuckled lightly—that laughter was aged and hoarse, like withered wood grinding: 'Recuperating? Hmph... This old man actually thinks your method of recuperation is somewhat different from ordinary people.'

These words sounded casual, yet murderous intent was already hidden within. Chen Ji's heart shivered, yet his expression remained unmoved; instead, he revealed a bitter smile: Disciple is foolish, indeed there were deviations in the cultivation method, making the sect master见笑 (laugh). Disciple will immediately return to his quarters for introspection...
No need to rush.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan raised his hand, stopping Chen Ji's attempt to take leave, a meaningful glint flickering in those murky eyes. This old man came here tonight originally to investigate the cause of those three disciples' deaths... yet I did not expect to have an unexpected harvest.

text.content: Chen Ji's heart violently sank, yet his expression still maintained a respectful demeanor. Ling Yuan's words clearly implied—he knew something. How much had this old fox overheard? Did he only sense Chen Ji's secret meeting with Ye Qing, or had he already learned the secret of Bloodline Awakening? Either situation was extremely unfavorable for him.

Ling Yuan took another step forward, the distance between him and Chen Ji now less than three zhang. For a Nascent Soul stage supreme expert, this distance was merely a blink of an eye. He slightly leaned forward, examining Chen Ji's face, a spine-chilling smile curling at the corner of his mouth: Chen Ji, do you know... you greatly resemble someone.

The night wind suddenly turned biting, like knives scraping bone. Chen Ji stood motionless, only the depths of his pupils flickering with a barely perceptible cold light. Ling Yuan's words were like a key, opening a certain long-sealed door—this old fox indeed knew something, and what he knew was far more than imagined.

However, just as the tension reached its peak, Ling Yuan suddenly withdrew his gaze, turning to look toward the Tianqing Sect. His expression turned grave, a complex light flickering in those murky eyes—calculation, wariness, and an emotion difficult to describe.

dialogue.content: Enough. Let tonight's events be recorded for now.

text.content: Ling Yuan tossed out these words, his figure flickering before vanishing into the night, as if he had never appeared at all. But Chen Ji knew this was merely the calm before the storm. Ling Yuan's performance tonight was far too unusual—he had clearly seized Chen Ji's weakness, yet suddenly withdrew. There must be something fishy about this.

Chen Ji inhaled deeply, gazing toward where Ling Yuan had vanished. His eyes gleamed with profound depth. Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in his mind, tinged with gravity: "Young master, Ling Yuan is an unfathomable individual. His sparing you tonight likely stems not from goodwill, but from waiting for a more opportune moment. You must be careful..."

Chen Ji did not respond. He merely stood quietly in place, allowing the night wind to stir his robes. So much had happened tonight—too much—the shock of bloodline awakening, the crisis of his identity being exposed, Su Qingyao's sudden appearance, the bizarre deaths of three disciples, and Ling Yuan's meaningful, penetrating gaze.

His fingers trembled slightly—a lingering aftereffect from suppressing his bloodline power. But what truly chilled his heart were the endless questions flooding his mind: Why would Chen Xuan share the same soul with the Demonic Path commander? What is the true origin of the Tianji Record? What other secrets lie dormant within his bloodline? And Ling Yuan... what exactly is that old fox scheming?

After a long while, Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes. When he opened them again, his gaze had regained its usual composure and profound depth. He lowered his head to look at his own hands, a faint smile curving his lips—a smile belonging to Chen Ji alone, carrying traces of self-mockery, of resolve, and even more so, of contempt for fate.
